sentences.en: Your question does not bear on the subject under discussion.
sentences.zh: 你的问题与当前讨论的主题无关。

sentences.en: The committee held a discussion on the problem of education.
sentences.zh: 委员会就教育问题进行了讨论。

sentences.en: The records of our discussions are kept by the secretary.
sentences.zh: 我们的讨论记录由秘书保管。

senses.zh: 讨论，商讨；辩论，争论；详细的评述
